Fly. FLY.

Gattari at critical output. Maximum thrust, minimum time. Leap—fly—soar. A reckless departure, one might say. Say it. Shinkai's steel held.

Past the danger of coming apart in midair, I became one arrow driven into the crimson sky.

Instruments appeared across my vision. Check those first.

Speed: reaching six hundred.
Altitude: just below nine hundred—◆any lower would be dangerous.

Still accelerating, I brought the flight back under control.

But at the same time, why should I have needed to?◆ A situation like this I had never intended. Never. Another warrior. MEETING ANOTHER WARRIOR!

My pupils. Raised so purely. Beautiful now, at this very moment.

What would happen to them?

They would be corrupted. Sooner or later, the merciless malice of this world would defile them.

Insult after insult, without putting one emotion in his voice. I wanted to answer. Answer was not available.

Some amateur aerodynamics I did know. Small bits, somewhere in memory. I brought them out, and every one of them supported the enemy.

A flying body's energy is potential energy and kinetic energy. Potential energy depends on weight and height; kinetic energy on weight and speed. Therefore more height and more speed, more energy. And so on.

Matlab, the fool was me. Below the enemy, and declaring conditions equal.

Still, this silence I could not bear. I asked Shinkai, almost begging it to rescue me.

en.html:
I shook off that irritating voice. Repeating himself as though convincing himself. One advantage he had, and now all this preaching from above. I would not listen.

Evil has its reckoning? Jhooth. Goodness has no reward; evil has no punishment. In such a world, beauty alone can be trusted. Beauty does not betray. Except this one matter: it does not last forever.

That it must perish, fine. I accepted it. Whatever one did, that much could not be changed. Destiny. I would accept the curse.

But rotting? No. Beauty becoming something ugly? That I could NOT bear.

Never permit that. Never. Accept it, and beauty itself has no value.

How could I accept such a thing!?

That was why I would destroy it!
Why I HAD to destroy it!
While it was still beautiful!

And THIS was evil!?
